statements.notes:
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, consume 1 scoop directly after workout with 6-10 oz of water or juice, or as directed by your physician.
On non-workout days consume first thing in the morning. No loading or cycling required.

Contents are sold by weight, not volume. Some settling may occur.
